result.brief: 提出因果对齐框架，用线性探针与因果干预定位视频生成模型中的相机自运动表征，并通过 delta-token 空间对齐 3D 基础模型，提升长时序几何一致性与具身任务成功率。
result.reason: Diagnoses and aligns ego-motion representations inside diffusion video generation models via causal intervention and 3D foundation model alignment, improving video world model consistency.
